subject: DeltaCardio | Private deployment playbook & next steps
summary: Onboard DeltaCardio to Redwood Private (VPC peering + private endpoints + on-prem package). Coordinate networking details, install window for on-prem package, hand off to EdgeHand for physical install, and collect required artifacts for SOC2/IT review.
messages:
From: Tom Rhee <trhee@deltacardio.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Melissa Ortiz <melissa.ortiz@deltacardio.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: DeltaCardio - private deployment kickoff

Hi Laura,

Thanks for taking this on. We're excited to move the private deployment forward. Attached is our current network diagram and IP allocations. High-level asks from our side:
- VPC peering to our prod VPC in us-west-2, minimal NAT changes
- Private endpoints for API traffic (no public egress for model traffic)
- On-prem package delivery to our secondary datacenter in Ashburn (EdgeHand will do the rack install)

Can we schedule a 60-minute networking review next week? Prefer Wed/Thu mornings PST. Also attaching a draft manifest from EdgeHand so you can see what they need.

Attaching: DeltaCardio_Network_Diagram_v1.pdf, EdgeHand_install_manifest.xlsx

Thanks,
Tom Rhee
Head of Infrastructure
DeltaCardio Systems

From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Tom Rhee <trhee@deltacardio.com>
Cc: Melissa Ortiz <melissa.ortiz@deltacardio.com>, dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: DeltaCardio - private deployment kickoff

Tom — thanks for the diagram and manifest. Quick notes up front:
- We can do VPC peering to your us-west-2 prod VPC; prefer to use a transit gateway for scalability but will accept peering if you have constraints.
- Private endpoints supported; we'll provide the endpoint IPs and DNS records to lock down egress.
- On-prem package: EdgeHand manifest looks fine. We'll need expected maintenance window and power/cabinet confirmation.

Suggested next steps:
1) 60-min networking review (Wed 21 Jul 9:30–10:30am PST) — propose calendar invite.
2) Share existing firewall ACLs and NAT/GW rules before the call.
3) We will prepare a "Redwood private playbook" draft for DC to review (includes peering options, routing, BGP sample, security controls).

Looping in Dev (solutions infra) and Monica (customer success) to lead the technical and onboarding tasks.

- Laura
Laura Bennett
Sr. Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Tom Rhee <trhee@deltacardio.com>
Cc: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2026 12:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: DeltaCardio - private deployment kickoff

Tom / Laura — quick technical checklist for the call so we can be efficient:
- VPC peering vs Transit Gateway: do you anticipate >10 VPCs or cross-account transits? If yes we'll push Transit Gateway.
- BGP adjacency details if TGW/Direct Connect used: local ASN, neighbor IPs, prefixes to advertise (we will request your allowed prefix list).
- Private endpoints: list of required subnets and whether you need IPv6; expected TLS termination (we support mutual TLS termination at private endpoint).
- KV cache persistence: will DC want the on-disk cache stored on the appliance? (affects disk sizing for on-prem package)
- Maintenance window preference for install: weekends vs weekdays; estimated 4-hour window for initial bring-up.

If you can pre-share ACLs and the EdgeHand rack PDUs/cabinet numbers that will help. I can draft BGP sample config before the call.

—Dev (Solutions Infra)

From: Melissa Ortiz <melissa.ortiz@deltacardio.com>
To: dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 08:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: DeltaCardio - private deployment kickoff

Thanks everyone — Wed 21 Jul 9:30am PST works for us. A few answers inline:
- We don't plan to exceed 10 VPCs in the near term; prefer the simpler peering arrangement for now.
- We can provide the BGP candidate ranges and current ACLs by EOD Tue.
- EdgeHand has provisioned the rack: 2RU reserved, 2x1200W PDUs, public IPs are NOT assigned at rack level; we will NAT behind our DMZ.
- On maintenance window: prefer Sat 00:00–04:00 local (ET) for initial bring-up — please confirm Redwood can support an overnight Saturday window.

I'll upload the ACL dump and EdgeHand contact information to the Drive folder.

—Melissa
Infrastructure Program Manager
DeltaCardio Systems

From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Melissa Ortiz <melissa.ortiz@deltacardio.com>, Tom Rhee <trhee@deltacardio.com>
Cc: dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, EdgeHand Install <install@edgehand.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2026 09:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: DeltaCardio - private deployment kickoff

Confirmed for Sat 24 Jul 00:00–04:00 ET for the initial on-prem package bring-up. Action items from today's networking review:
- Redwood to produce draft playbook (peering + sample BGP + private endpoint DNS steps) — owner: Dev; delivery: Fri 23 Jul 16:00 PT. (attachment: redwood-private-playbook-templates.zip)
- DeltaCardio to share ACL export and EdgeHand cabinet/PDU photos — owner: Melissa; delivery: Tue 21 Jul EOD (received).
- EdgeHand to confirm onsite engineer name and contact — owner: EdgeHand; delivery: Thu 22 Jul end of day.
- Laura/Monica to schedule the go/no-go sync for Fri 23 Jul 11:00am PT.

Notes from the call: for simplicity we'll start with VPC peering (no TGW). We'll ask DeltaCardio to reserve a /27 for private endpoints and provide explicit allowed source prefixes.

I've attached the draft playbook bundle; Dev will send BGP sample snippets in a follow-up.

Thanks — Laura

From: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Tom Rhee <trhee@deltacardio.com>, Melissa Ortiz <melissa.ortiz@deltacardio.com>, EdgeHand Install <install@edgehand.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2026 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: DeltaCardio - private deployment kickoff — final checklist and docs

All — moving to checklist status. Final items before Sat window:
1) Redwood: deliver BGP sample + endpoint IP list (Dev) — DONE (see attachment in Drive).
2) DeltaCardio: confirm ACLs and reserve /27 for endpoints — DONE.
3) EdgeHand: onsite engineer is Miguel Santos + phone + backup engineer — ON TRACK (install@edgehand.com provided manifest).
4) Legal/Proc: signed MSA and SOW (DocuSign link below) — PENDING signature by DeltaCardio legal.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/req/abc123-deltacardio-nda
Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-DCARDIO-KICKOFF

Monica will run the go/no-go on Fri 23 Jul 11:00am PT and capture rollback playbook for the Sat window. If we get sign-off, Redwood will ship the on-prem package to EdgeHand on Thu 22 Jul overnight freight.

—Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
